extended.interpretationNote: Carries the back bearing bushes of the UK arbors and the FR back dials; four circular openings clear of the seats, the dial screws and the exhibit lighting pass-through connector (modern item).

extended.interpretationNote: Corner pillars between the plates, screwed to the side boards.

proposedDefects.detail: Pin-and-slot pair k1/k2: the DE mesh record expects k2 with 50 teeth; the UK part UK/3203 records 48.
proposedDefects.needs: A mesh rule over extended.meshes: the driven part's own tooth count equals the count the record expects, both gears share the module, the arbor centre distance equals module x (z1 + z2) / 2 within toleranceMm, and a pin-and-slot pair has equal counts. Requires tooth counts and arbor positions in the PLM mappings.

proposedDefects.detail: FR3203 references urn:plm:de:part:D-32008 at revision 01, which is Ersetzt (SUPERSEDED); the released revision is 02.
proposedDefects.needs: A revision rule over extended.externalRefs: the expected revision of an external reference is the current released revision of the target. Requires revision and lifecycle columns in the PLM mappings.

proposedDefects.detail: FR3204 references urn:plm:es:pieza:ES-3203, which is not a urn:plm:<site>:part:<local id> key and resolves to no part; its physical echo is the orphan plug FR3204-J01 (ES-3203-C01 sits at its position).
proposedDefects.needs: A reference rule: every external reference parses as urn:plm:(de|fr|es|uk):part:<local id> and resolves to exactly one part. Requires the external reference tables in the PLM mappings.
